entries.source:
Warrior Ancient armor is a prestige art type available in the Nightfall campaign. This armor is crafted by Palmod in the Bone Palace.

There is no standard version of Ancient armor.



* The leggings of this Armor Set are a reskin of the Istani Armor Set leggings.
entries.text:
戰士古代護甲是《黑暗逆襲》的高階護甲外觀，由 Bone Palace 的 Palmod 製作。

古代護甲沒有一般版本。

這套護甲的護腿沿用戰士艾斯坦護腿的模型，並更換貼圖。
entries.reason: 核對製作商及所在地；prestige指高階外觀，reskin指沿用模型更換貼圖，不是改造配方。

entries.source:
Warrior Ascalon armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as starter armor and it is also available in the Factions campaign. It can only be crafted up to armor rating 59 in Prophecies, but can be crafted in Factions up to max armor rating. The helm is only available without attribute bonus in Prophecies, but with any warrior attribute in Factions.

There is no prestige version of Ascalon armor.

Note: The starter helm is named "Recruit's Cap" and the rest of the starter pieces are named "Ringmail".
entries.text:
戰士阿斯卡隆護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》推出的初始護甲外觀，也可在《盟與敵》取得。在《阿斯卡隆戰記》只能製作至防禦等級 59；在《盟與敵》則可製作至最高防禦等級。《阿斯卡隆戰記》的頭盔沒有屬性加成；《盟與敵》的頭盔則有各種戰士屬性加成可選。

阿斯卡隆護甲沒有高階版本。

初始頭盔名為 Recruit's Cap，其餘初始部位名為 Ringmail。
entries.reason: 核對兩戰役的59與最高防禦限制、頭盔屬性選擇及初始部位命名，不把helm譯成安全帽。

entries.source:
Warrior Asuran armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Not Too Annoying) in the Asura title track to be able to craft this armor.



* This armor has some similarities to Warrior Elite Kurzick armor, apart from the helm which is slightly remodeled.
entries.text:
戰士阿蘇拉護甲是《極地之眼》資料片的高階護甲外觀。製作前，阿蘇拉稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Not Too Annoying）。

除了略經修改的頭盔外，這套護甲與戰士精英庫茲柯護甲有若干相似之處。
entries.reason: 修正title track為稱號進度；保留第5級門檻及只有頭盔略經修改的比較。

entries.source:
Warrior Canthan armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign both as crafted armor and as collector armor for the region of Kaineng City.

The prestige version of this armor is Warrior Elite Canthan armor.
entries.text:
戰士凱珊護甲是《盟與敵》的護甲外觀，可透過製作取得，也可向凱寧城地區的收藏家兌換。

此護甲的高階版本是戰士精英凱珊護甲。
entries.reason: 核對製作與收藏家兌換為兩種取得方式，凱寧城地區限定收藏家而非所有製作商。

entries.source:
Warrior Charr Hide armor is an art type available in the Prophecies campaign. Available Post-Searing not Pre-Searing. 

The prestige version of this armor is Warrior Elite Charr Hide armor.
entries.text:
戰士夏爾皮護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的護甲外觀，只能在災變後取得，災變前無法取得。

此護甲的高階版本是戰士精英夏爾皮護甲。
entries.reason: 修正災變前後條件；保留一般與精英版本的對應，不把不可取得寫成前後皆有。

entries.source:
Warrior Elite Canthan armor is a prestige art type available in the Factions campaign.

This armor is only available in the Divine Path, an explorable area only accessible by completing Imperial Sanctum. If you plan on buying this armor make sure you take all of the required crafting materials and money into the mission with you, as there are no Xunlai Agents, material traders, or rare material traders available in the zone.

The standard version of this armor is Warrior Canthan armor.
entries.text:
戰士精英凱珊護甲是《盟與敵》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲只能在 Divine Path 取得；這個探索區域只能在完成 Imperial Sanctum 後進入。若打算購買，進入該合作任務前須帶齊製作所需材料與金錢，因為此區沒有 Xunlai Agent、材料商人或稀有材料商人。

此護甲的一般版本是戰士凱珊護甲。
entries.reason: 核對通關後才可進入的區域與必須事先攜帶材料、金錢；不把材料誤寫為任務本身所需，專名保留英文身份。

entries.source:
Warrior Elite Charr Hide armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign. 

The standard version of this armor is Warrior Charr Hide armor.



* This armor is labeled Marhan's Grotto Elite Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
entries.text:
戰士精英夏爾皮護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是戰士夏爾皮護甲。

在史蹟殿堂的「Resilience」紀念碑中，此護甲標示為 Marhan's Grotto Elite Armor。
entries.reason: 核對一般版本及紀念碑中的完整英文標籤；Elite是標籤的一部分，不與Exclusive或Ascended互換。

entries.source:
Warrior Elite Dragon armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Warrior Wyvern armor.



* This armor is labeled Granite Citadel Exclusive Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
The neck appears twisted for the female model
entries.text:
戰士精英巨龍護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是戰士飛龍護甲。

在史蹟殿堂的「Resilience」紀念碑中，此護甲標示為 Granite Citadel Exclusive Armor。
女性模型的頸部看起來扭曲。
entries.reason: 核對巨龍高階與飛龍一般版本的非同名對應；保留完整紀念碑標籤及女性模型頸部問題。

entries.source:
Warrior Elite Gladiator armor is a prestige art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Warrior Gladiator armor.



* This armor is labeled Marhan's Grotto Exclusive Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
* The leggings on the male version of this armor wrap around the leg incorrectly, causing clipping with itself.
entries.text:
戰士精英劍鬥士護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》推出的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是戰士劍鬥士護甲。

在史蹟殿堂的「Resilience」紀念碑中，此護甲標示為 Marhan's Grotto Exclusive Armor。
男性版本的護腿未正確環繞腿部，導致護腿自身穿模。
entries.reason: clipping指模型穿透，不是腿被夾住；核對男性限定與護腿自身相交，保留Exclusive完整標籤。

entries.source:
Warrior Elite Kurzick armor is a prestige art type available in the Factions campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Warrior Kurzick armor.



* The male helm has a clipping error with the cuirass when standing still. This is seen best at the character selection screen. It can also be seen easily while performing the dance emote.
entries.text:
戰士精英庫茲柯護甲是《盟與敵》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是戰士庫茲柯護甲。

男性頭盔在角色站立不動時會與胸甲穿模。角色選擇畫面最容易看出，做跳舞表情動作時也很明顯。
entries.reason: 核對男性頭盔與胸甲穿模，不是剪裁誤差；保留站立、角色選擇與跳舞三個觀察情境。

entries.source:
Warrior Elite Luxon armor is a prestige art type available in the Factions campaign. 

The standard version of this armor is Warrior Luxon armor.
entries.text:
戰士精英勒克森護甲是《盟與敵》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是 Warrior Luxon armor。
entries.reason: 保留精英與一般版本對應；一般版本未有完整可靠中文名稱身份，沿用已審名稱的英文。

entries.source:
Warrior Elite Platemail armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Warrior Platemail armor.



* This armor is labeled Granite Citadel Ascended Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
The male version of this armor has clipping issues with guild capes.
entries.text:
戰士精英金屬板護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是戰士金屬板護甲。

在史蹟殿堂的「Resilience」紀念碑中，此護甲標示為 Granite Citadel Ascended Armor。
男性版本搭配公會斗篷時會穿模。
entries.reason: 核對Ascended完整標籤及公會斗篷穿模的男性限定；不把穿模譯為剪裁。

entries.source:
Warrior Elite Templar armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign. It was added to the game in the April 20th 2007 update.

The standard version of this armor is Warrior Templar armor.



* This armor is labeled Marhan's Grotto Ascended Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
entries.text:
戰士精英騎士護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的高階護甲外觀，於 2007 年 4 月 20 日更新加入遊戲。

此護甲的一般版本是戰士騎士護甲。

在史蹟殿堂的「Resilience」紀念碑中，此護甲標示為 Marhan's Grotto Ascended Armor。
entries.reason: 校正更新日期順序；核對一般版本與完整Ascended紀念碑標籤，不改歷史時間。

entries.source:
Warrior Gladiator armor is an art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Warrior Elite Gladiator armor.
entries.text:
戰士劍鬥士護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的護甲外觀。

此護甲的高階版本是戰士精英劍鬥士護甲。
entries.reason: 核對職業、戰役及精英版本對應；art type是護甲外觀，不是藝術型別。

entries.source:
Warrior Heavy Breastplate is a prestige armor piece available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor. 



*The male breastplate shares the same model as the Warrior Charr Hide armor breastplate 
*The female breastplate is a reskin of the regular Templar armor breastplate.
entries.text:
戰士沉重胸甲是《極地之眼》資料片的高階護甲部位。製作前，戴爾狄摩稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Bold Delver）。

男性胸甲與戰士夏爾皮胸甲使用相同模型。
女性胸甲沿用一般戰士騎士胸甲的模型，並更換貼圖。
entries.reason: 核對第5級與男女不同參照；same model與reskin分開描述，女性不是參照精英版本。

entries.source:
Warrior Ironfist Gauntlets is a prestige armor piece available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



*The male model is a reskin of the Elite Dragon gauntlets, while the female is a reskin of the Elite Templar gauntlets.
entries.text:
戰士鐵拳護手是《極地之眼》資料片的高階護甲部位。製作前，戴爾狄摩稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Bold Delver）。

男性版本沿用精英巨龍護手的模型並更換貼圖；女性版本則沿用精英騎士護手的模型並更換貼圖。
entries.reason: 核對男女分別對應精英巨龍與精英騎士，不把reskin誤作不同模型；保留第5級門檻。

entries.source:
Warrior Istani armor is an art type available in the Nightfall campaign, as starter armor, collector armor for the region of Istan, and as regular crafted armor. The collector helm is only available with a Strength +1 bonus.

There is no prestige version of Istani armor.
entries.text:
戰士艾斯坦護甲是《黑暗逆襲》的護甲外觀，可作為初始護甲、向艾斯坦地區收藏家兌換，或透過一般製作取得。收藏家提供的頭盔只有力量 +1 的版本。

艾斯坦護甲沒有高階版本。
entries.reason: 核對三種取得方式及收藏家頭盔唯一的力量+1加成；不是任何使用條件或額外獎勵。

entries.source:
Warrior Krytan armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as collector armor and is also craft-able in the Factions campaign. 

There is no prestige version of Krytan armor.
entries.text:
戰士科瑞塔護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》推出的收藏家兌換護甲外觀，也可在《盟與敵》製作。

科瑞塔護甲沒有高階版本。
entries.reason: 核對收藏家兌換與另一戰役的製作方式；保留沒有高階版本的限制。

entries.source:
Warrior Kurzick armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Warrior Elite Kurzick armor.
entries.text:
戰士庫茲柯護甲是《盟與敵》的護甲外觀。

此護甲的高階版本是戰士精英庫茲柯護甲。
entries.reason: 逐項核對職業、戰役與精英對應；移除藝術型別及活動的直譯。

entries.source:
Warrior Luxon armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Warrior Elite Luxon armor.
entries.text:
Warrior Luxon armor 是《盟與敵》的護甲外觀。

此護甲的高階版本是戰士精英勒克森護甲。
entries.reason: 依已審名稱保留一般版本英文身份，精英版本採固定中文名稱；核對兩者對應及戰役。

entries.source: Warrior Norn armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Slayer of Wurms) in the Norn title track to be able to craft this armor.
entries.text: 戰士諾恩護甲是《極地之眼》資料片的高階護甲外觀。製作前，諾恩稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Slayer of Wurms）。
entries.reason: 修正title track誤譯並保留第5級製作門檻；稱號級名缺少固定中文身份，保留英文。

entries.source:
Warrior Obsidian armor is a prestige art type available to players from all campaigns.



* In order for the Eternal Forgemaster to appear in The Fissure of Woe, players must complete the following quests:
** The Eternal Forgemaster
** Defend the Temple of War
** Restore the Temple of War
entries.text:
Warrior Obsidian armor 是所有戰役的玩家都可取得的高階護甲外觀。

要讓 Eternal Forgemaster 在 The Fissure of Woe 出現，玩家必須完成以下任務：
The Eternal Forgemaster
Defend the Temple of War
Restore the Temple of War
entries.reason: 核對所有戰役皆可取得及三項必須完成的任務；保持出現條件，不改為僅製作條件，未證專名保留英文。

entries.source:
Warrior Platemail armor is an art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Warrior Elite Platemail armor.
entries.text:
戰士金屬板護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的護甲外觀。

此護甲的高階版本是戰士精英金屬板護甲。
entries.reason: 核對職業、戰役和一般至精英的對應；統一護甲外觀與高階版本用語。

entries.source:
Warrior Primeval armor is a prestige art type available in the Nightfall campaign. 

This armor is only available in the Throne of Secrets, an explorable area only accessible by completing the final mission in Nightfall. If you plan on buying this armor make sure you take all of the required crafting materials and money into the mission with you, as there are no Xunlai Agents, material traders, or rare material traders available in the zone.

There is no standard version of Primeval armor.



* This armor has clipping issues with most shields.
* Female version of this armor has clipping issues with capes.
* The Helmet has clipping issues when the warrior talks during a cut-scene.
entries.text:
戰士太古護甲是《黑暗逆襲》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲只能在 Throne of Secrets 取得；這個探索區域只能在完成《黑暗逆襲》的最後一個合作任務後進入。若打算購買，進入該合作任務前須帶齊製作所需材料與金錢，因為此區沒有 Xunlai Agent、材料商人或稀有材料商人。

太古護甲沒有一般版本。

此護甲搭配大多數盾牌時會穿模。
女性版本搭配斗篷時會穿模。
戰士在過場動畫中說話時，頭盔會穿模。
entries.reason: 核對終章完成後才可進入及事先攜帶材料；逐項保留盾牌、女性斗篷與過場說話的穿模條件。

entries.source:
Warrior Shing Jea armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign, as starter armor (named Recruit's armor), collector armor for the region of Shing Jea Island, and as regular craftable armor.

There is no prestige version of Shing Jea armor.
entries.text:
戰士星岬護甲是《盟與敵》的護甲外觀，可作為初始護甲（名為 Recruit's armor）、向星岬島地區收藏家兌換，或透過一般製作取得。

星岬護甲沒有高階版本。
entries.reason: 核對三種取得方式及初始名稱；保留星岬島收藏家範圍，不把新兵初始名套在所有版本。

entries.source:
Warrior Silver Eagle armor is a prestige art type available in the Guild Wars Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



*This armor is exclusive to warriors; there is no equivalent for other professions.
*Since the September 28, 2007 game update, this armor set can be added to the Hall of Monuments.
*This armor has a glitch on the neck with all capes.
*The male Silver Eagle Gauntlets have clipping issues with most shields.
entries.text:
戰士銀鷹護甲是《極地之眼》資料片的高階護甲外觀。製作前，戴爾狄摩稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Bold Delver）。

此護甲為戰士專屬，其他職業沒有對應外觀。
自 2007 年 9 月 28 日更新起，此套護甲可陳列於史蹟殿堂。
此護甲搭配任何斗篷時，頸部都會出現顯示錯誤。
男性銀鷹護手搭配大多數盾牌時會穿模。
entries.reason: 核對其他職業沒有對應護甲而非沒有職業；校正更新日期、所有斗篷與大多數盾牌的範圍差異。

entries.source:
Warrior Stalwart Leggings is a prestige armor piece available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



*The female model is a reskinned regular Templar leggings, and the male one is regular Kurzick.
entries.text:
戰士英勇護腿是《極地之眼》資料片的高階護甲部位。製作前，戴爾狄摩稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Bold Delver）。

女性版本沿用一般騎士護腿的模型並更換貼圖；男性版本則沿用一般庫茲柯護腿的模型並更換貼圖。
entries.reason: 核對男女分別參照一般騎士及一般庫茲柯；reskin是更換貼圖，兩者都不是精英護甲。

entries.source:

entries.text:
戰士剛毅長靴是《極地之眼》資料片的高階護甲部位。製作前，戴爾狄摩稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Bold Delver）。

男性靴子沿用騎士靴子的模型並更換貼圖；女性靴子則沿用金屬板靴子的模型並更換貼圖。
entries.reason: 修正重皮誤譯；核對男性騎士、女性金屬板的對應及第5級製作門檻。

戰士日戟護甲是《黑暗逆襲》的護甲外觀。

此護甲的高階版本是戰士精英日戟護甲。
entries.reason: 核對職業、戰役與精英版本對應；統一護甲外觀用語。

entries.source:

entries.text:

entries.source:
Mesmer Asuran armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Not Too Annoying) in the Asura title track to be able to craft this armor.



* When zooming out viewing the female armor, the dye on the dress will always have red accents, regardless of the color of the dye applied.
* The earrings on the female armor have clipping issues with some hairstyles.
* The Female version of this armor seems to be a reskin of Female Mesmer Elite Noble armor. The male seems to be a reskin of Enchanter armor.
entries.text:
幻術師阿蘇拉護甲是《極地之眼》資料片的高階護甲外觀。製作前，阿蘇拉稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Not Too Annoying）。

拉遠視角觀看女性護甲時，不論使用哪種染料，裙裝都會顯示紅色點綴。
女性護甲的耳環搭配某些髮型時會穿模。
女性版本看起來沿用女性幻術師精英貴族護甲的模型並更換貼圖；男性版本看起來沿用附魔護甲的模型並更換貼圖。
entries.reason: 移除Enchanter人物模板污染的傭兵誤譯；保留模型比對的seems不確定性、拉遠視角和染料無關的紅色點綴。

entries.source:
Mesmer Canthan armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign as collector armor for the region of Kaineng City, and as regular crafted armor.

The prestige version of this armor is Mesmer Elite Canthan armor.
entries.text:
幻術師凱珊護甲是《盟與敵》的護甲外觀，可向凱寧城地區的收藏家兌換，或透過一般製作取得。

此護甲的高階版本是幻術師精英凱珊護甲。
entries.reason: 核對收藏家地區只約束兌換途徑；保留一般製作與精英凱珊對應。

entries.source: The Mesmer Costume Mask is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign. It comes with an Illusion Magic +1 bonus up to max armor level and with any mesmer attribute bonus at max armor level.
entries.text: 幻術師幻影面罩是《阿斯卡隆戰記》推出的面具外觀，也可在《盟與敵》取得。最高防禦等級前，面具具有幻術魔法 +1 加成；最高防禦等級的版本則可選擇任一幻術師屬性加成。
entries.reason: 核對+1為幻術魔法屬性加成，不是護甲等級增加；最高防禦版本可選任一屬性，並非同時全部。

entries.source:
Mesmer Courtly armor is an art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Mesmer Elite Noble armor.
entries.text:
幻術師優雅護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的護甲外觀。

此護甲的高階版本是幻術師精英貴族護甲。
entries.reason: 核對Courtly與Elite Noble非同名但相對應的外觀，採既有已審中文名稱。

entries.source: The Mesmer Discreet Mask is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as starter armor (named Mesmer Mask). It can also be crafted in Prophecies without attribute bonus up to max armor level and with any attribute bonus at max armor level, and in Factions at max armor level with an attribute bonus only.
entries.text: 幻術師慎重面罩是《阿斯卡隆戰記》推出的初始護甲外觀（名為 Mesmer Mask）。在《阿斯卡隆戰記》可製作沒有屬性加成的版本，防禦等級最高可達上限；最高防禦等級亦可製作成具有任一屬性加成的版本。在《盟與敵》則只有最高防禦等級且附帶屬性加成的版本。
entries.reason: 核對阿斯卡隆戰記無屬性版本可達最高防禦、最高防禦另可選屬性；盟與敵只提供最高防禦附屬性版本，保留up to包含上限。

entries.source:
Mesmer Elegant Long Coat is an art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



* The female version has clipping issues in the front when viewed zoomed out.
* The female version seems to be a reskin of the Kurzick attire.
* The male version seems to be a reskin of the Elite Enchanter Attire.
entries.text:
幻術師優雅長袍是《極地之眼》資料片的護甲外觀。製作前，戴爾狄摩稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Bold Delver）。

拉遠視角觀看時，女性版本的正面會穿模。
女性版本看起來沿用庫茲柯上衣的模型並更換貼圖。
男性版本看起來沿用精英附魔上衣的模型並更換貼圖。
entries.reason: 核對第5級與女性遠視穿模；移除Elite Enchanter人物模板傭兵污染，保留兩處seems比對的不確定性。

entries.source:
Mesmer Elite Canthan armor is a prestige art type available in the Factions campaign.

This armor is only available in the Divine Path, an explorable area only accessible by completing Imperial Sanctum. If you plan on buying this armor make sure you take all of the required crafting materials and money into the mission with you, as there are no Xunlai Agents, material traders, or rare material traders available in the zone.

The standard version of this armor is Mesmer Canthan armor.
entries.text:
幻術師精英凱珊護甲是《盟與敵》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲只能在 Divine Path 取得；這個探索區域只能在完成 Imperial Sanctum 後進入。若打算購買，進入該合作任務前須帶齊製作所需材料與金錢，因為此區沒有 Xunlai Agent、材料商人或稀有材料商人。

此護甲的一般版本是幻術師凱珊護甲。
entries.reason: 核對通關後區域及任務開始前須備齊護甲製作材料和錢；保留一般凱珊對應及未證專名。

entries.source:
Mesmer Elite Elegant armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Mesmer Performer armor.



* This armor is labeled Granite Citadel Ascended Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
*The female variation of the armor can clip or bleed-through on the back portion of the coat's neck with some character hair styles.
*Part of the sleeve on the male attire appears green when dyed certain colors.
entries.text:
幻術師精英藝術家護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是幻術師表演者護甲。

在史蹟殿堂的「Resilience」紀念碑中，此護甲標示為 Granite Citadel Ascended Armor。
女性版本搭配某些髮型時，外套後領會穿模或出現髮型穿透的顯示問題。
男性上衣袖子的部分區域在染成某些顏色時會呈現綠色。
entries.reason: 核對女性後領髮型與男性袖口染色兩項不同問題；保留指定髮型、某些染色及完整Ascended標籤。

entries.source:
Mesmer Elite Enchanter armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Mesmer Enchanter armor.



*This armor is labeled Marhan's Grotto Elite Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
*Any dye applied onto the female hose (leg piece) is somewhat redundant as it gets obscured by the attire (chest piece).
*The male leggings may sometimes clip through the coat during some emotes such as /guitar.
*The male leggings clip through the boots when sitting.
entries.text:
幻術師精英附魔護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是幻術師附魔護甲。

在史蹟殿堂的「Resilience」紀念碑中，此護甲標示為 Marhan's Grotto Elite Armor。
女性長褲（腿甲）會被上衣（胸甲）遮住，因此替長褲染色的作用有限。
男性長褲在 /guitar 等某些表情動作中，有時會穿過外套。
男性長褲在坐下時會穿過靴子。
entries.reason: 修正hose為長褲及/guitar原始指令；核對染色被胸甲遮蔽、男性表情時偶發與坐姿靴子穿模。

entries.source:
Mesmer Elite Kurzick armor is a prestige art type available in the Factions campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Mesmer Kurzick armor.



* The female version has a clipping issue on the right shoulder.
* Sitting down with the female version results in clipping issues such as the hands going through the skirt.
* The male version's jacket sometimes clips with capes while running diagonally.
entries.text:
幻術師精英庫茲柯護甲是《盟與敵》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是幻術師庫茲柯護甲。

女性版本的右肩會穿模。
女性版本坐下時會穿模，例如手穿過裙子。
男性外套在斜向奔跑時，有時會與斗篷穿模。
entries.reason: 核對女性右肩與坐姿、男性斜向奔跑不同條件；running diagonally是斜跑，不只是斜行。

entries.source:
Mesmer Elite Luxon armor is a prestige armor art type available in the Factions campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Mesmer Luxon armor.



* The male Mask uses the same model as Mesmer Kurzick armor.
entries.text:
幻術師精英勒克森護甲是《盟與敵》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是幻術師勒克森護甲。

男性面具與幻術師庫茲柯護甲的面具使用相同模型。
entries.reason: 核對相同模型只約束男性面具，不延伸至全套護甲；model不譯成機型。

entries.source:
Mesmer Elite Noble armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Mesmer Courtly armor.



* This armor is labeled Granite Citadel Elite Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
entries.text:
幻術師精英貴族護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是幻術師優雅護甲。

在史蹟殿堂的「Resilience」紀念碑中，此護甲標示為 Granite Citadel Elite Armor。
entries.reason: 核對一般優雅至精英貴族的非同名對應，保留Granite Citadel Elite完整標籤。

entries.source:
Mesmer Elite Rogue armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Mesmer Rogue armor.



* This armor is labeled Marhan's Grotto Exclusive Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.

There is a small red splotch on the male hose, just below the belt.
entries.text:
幻術師精英惡漢護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是幻術師惡漢護甲。

在史蹟殿堂的「Resilience」紀念碑中，此護甲標示為 Marhan's Grotto Exclusive Armor。
男性長褲的腰帶正下方有一小塊紅色斑點。
entries.reason: 修正male hose為男性長褲而非公軟管；核對斑點大小與腰帶正下方位置，保留完整Exclusive標籤。
